versions.changelog:
- Added _meta.json for skill metadata; removed skill-card.md.
- SKILL.md updated to standardize frontmatter, add version and tags fields, and expand usage scenarios.
- No core methodology or workflow changes; all strategic modules and acceptance criteria remain intact.
- Documentation enhancements improve discoverability and clarity of use cases for international search marketing.

- Improved documentation: Skill name and description now highlight instant, full-funnel international search strategy planning (SEO and SEM).
- Detailed framework: Expanded guidance on keyword intent localization, paid-search budget allocation, and technical SEO architecture choices.
- Real-world prompts: Added example use cases for China/Russia SEO structure, Japan/Korea SEM, and multi-market PPC budget allocation.
- Measurement focus: Includes a measurement and iteration dashboard with market-specific benchmarks and regular review scheduling.
- Acceptance criteria: Clearly defined skill outputs, coverage of multiple search ecosystems, intent-based localization, and practical decision support for global search marketing.

Initial release of cross-border SEO and SEM strategy guide.

- Provides a structured framework for international search marketing planning.
- Covers regional search ecosystem mapping, intent-based keyword localization, and technical SEO architecture choices.
- Includes modules for SERP feature strategy, paid-search budget allocation, and market-specific measurement dashboards.
- Lists required inputs for effective strategy (product catalog, market list, site structure, paid search activity, etc.).
- Outlines workflows and decision criteria for both organic and paid search in multiple international markets.
- Defines clear acceptance criteria to ensure strategic quality and market adaptability.
